description: This file defines interfaces for user settings management, including notifications for setting changes, and migration state tracking within the WPEFramework Exchange namespace. It includes the IUserSettings interface with methods to get/set various user preferences and the IUserSettingsInspector for migration status.

classes.name: IUserSettings
classes.description: Interface for managing user settings such as audio description, language preferences, captions, privacy, parental controls, and watershed settings.

classes.name: IUserSettings::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for receiving callbacks when user settings change.

classes.name: IUserSettingsInspector
classes.description: Interface for inspecting migration states of user settings keys.

classes.name: IUserSettings::SettingsMigrationState
classes.description: Structure representing the migration state of a specific user setting key.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for user setting changes.

methods.name: SetPreferredAudioLanguages
methods.description: Sets preferred audio languages as a comma-separated list.

methods.name: SetPresentationLanguage
methods.description: Sets presentation language in BCP 47 format.

methods.name: GetPreferredClosedCaptionService
methods.description: Gets current preferred closed caption service.

methods.name: SetLiveWatershed
methods.description: Enables or disables live watershed rules.

methods.name: SetPlaybackWatershed
methods.description: Enables or disables playback watershed rules.

methods.name: SetBlockNotRatedContent
methods.description: Enables or disables blocking of not rated content.

methods.name: GetBlockNotRatedContent
methods.description: Retrieves block not rated content setting.

methods.name: SetPinOnPurchase
methods.description: Enables or disables PIN requirement on purchase.

methods.name: SetHighContrast
methods.description: Enables or disables high contrast mode.

methods.name: SetVoiceGuidanceHints
methods.description: Enables or disables voice guidance hints.

methods.name: GetMigrationState
methods.description: Checks if a specific setting key requires migration.

methods.name: GetMigrationStates
methods.description: Retrieves migration states for all keys.
